+def repulsion_optimize(points, steps=200, decay=0.95, weight=1.0):
+    """Move points to maximize sum(1/dist), improving minimum angle."""
+    n = len(points)
+    pts = [list(p) for p in points]
+    for _ in range(steps):
+        grad = [[0.0, 0.0, 0.0] for _ in range(n)]
+        for i in range(n):
+            for j in range(i + 1, n):
+                vx = pts[i][0] - pts[j][0]
+                vy = pts[i][1] - pts[j][1]
+                vz = pts[i][2] - pts[j][2]
+                dist_sq = vx*vx + vy*vy + vz*vz
+                dist = math.sqrt(dist_sq)
+                if dist > 1e-6:
+                    s = 1.0 + weight
+                    f = 1.0 / (dist ** (s - 1))
+                    grad[i][0] += f * vx / dist
+                    grad[i][1] += f * vy / dist
+                    grad[i][2] += f * vz / dist
+                    grad[j][0] -= f * vx / dist
+                    grad[j][1] -= f * vy / dist
+                    grad[j][2] -= f * vz / dist
+        
+        # Move and renormalize
+        step = 1.0 * decay
+        for i in range(n):
+            pts[i][0] += grad[i][0] * step
+            pts[i][1] += grad[i][1] * step
+            pts[i][2] += grad[i][2] * step
+            norm = math.sqrt(pts[i][0]**2 + pts[i][1]**2 + pts[i][2]**2)
+            if norm > 0:
+                pts[i][0] /= norm
+                pts[i][1] /= norm
+                pts[i][2] /= norm
+    return pts
